text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unconsciously taking an unplanned 
action... ...It's not entirely impossible, 
but quite curious nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...A goddess statue. Fufu, did you 
perhaps have business with me?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I may be of service, I would gladly 
listen. ...Just kidding.
